details.usage: AmE yazımı offense; take offence at something.

examples.text: Don't take offence, it was just a joke.

details.usage: Resmî dil; özne bir durumdur.

examples.text: The decision gave rise to protests.

details.usage: Mahkemede ifade vermek; evidence sayılamaz.

examples.text: She gave evidence in court.

details.usage: Resmî: pay tribute to someone = övgüyle anmak.

examples.text: The team paid tribute to their former coach.

details.usage: Genelde cenaze bağlamında; respects çoğul.

examples.text: Many people came to pay their respects.

details.usage: Kalıp: catch a glimpse of someone/something.

examples.text: I caught a glimpse of the singer.

details.usage: Zor bir durumu içselleştirmek: come to terms with a loss.

examples.text: She hasn't come to terms with her father's death.

details.usage: Her iki taraf da bir şeyden vazgeçer.

examples.text: We reached a compromise after long talks.
examples.tr: Uzun görüşmelerden sonra orta yolu bulduk.

details.usage: Resmî dilde sık; raise concerns about something.

examples.text: The report raised concerns about safety.
examples.tr: Rapor güvenlikle ilgili endişelere yol açtı.

details.usage: take a risk'e yakın; run the risk of doing something.

examples.text: You run the risk of losing everything.

details.usage: Karşıtı: lose face = itibar kaybetmek.

examples.text: He apologised to save face.

details.usage: Resmî dil; "provide requirements" yanlış.

examples.text: Your application doesn't meet our requirements.

details.usage: Ekonomi dilinde: meet the demand for something.

examples.text: Factories can't meet the demand.

details.usage: Resmî: draw a distinction between A and B.

examples.text: We must draw a distinction between facts and opinions.

details.usage: Resmî; make a comparison da olur.

examples.text: He drew a comparison between the two cities.
examples.tr: İki şehir arasında bir karşılaştırma yaptı.

details.usage: Kabul edilebilir olanın sınırı: draw the line at something.

examples.text: I don't mind helping, but I draw the line at lying.
examples.tr: Yardım etmeye itirazım yok ama yalan söylemekte sınırı çizerim.

details.usage: Özne ilgi çeken şeydir: The concert drew a big crowd.

examples.text: The street musician drew a large crowd.
examples.tr: Sokak müzisyeni büyük bir kalabalık topladı.

details.usage: Resmî; bear = yüklenmek, taşımak.

examples.text: Who will bear the cost of repairs?

details.usage: Kalıp: bear a (strong) resemblance to someone.

examples.text: She bears a strong resemblance to her mother.

details.usage: Resmî; take responsibility = sorumluluğu üstlenmek.

examples.text: Parents bear responsibility for their children.

details.usage: Mecazi: amacı unutmak; gerçek: gözden kaybetmek.

examples.text: Don't lose sight of your goals.

details.usage: Resmî: gain access to something.

examples.text: The hackers gained access to the system.

details.usage: Özne bir şey ya da kişidir.

examples.text: The app quickly gained popularity.

details.usage: Resmî/hukuki; AmE yazımı offense.

examples.text: He committed an offence by driving without a licence.

details.usage: Haber dilinde sık.

examples.text: The minister faced criticism over the decision.

details.usage: Resmî; pose a risk / pose a question da olur.

examples.text: The virus poses a threat to public health.
examples.tr: Virüs halk sağlığı için tehdit oluşturuyor.

details.usage: "make a balance" yanlış; strike a balance between A and B.

examples.text: It's hard to strike a balance between work and family.
examples.tr: İş ile aile arasında denge kurmak zor.

details.usage: "start a campaign" da olur; launch daha resmî.

examples.text: The charity launched a new campaign.
examples.tr: Yardım kuruluşu yeni bir kampanya başlattı.

details.usage: do research'ün resmî karşılığı.

examples.text: The university conducts research on cancer.

details.usage: Resmî: seek advice from someone; gündelikte ask for advice.

examples.text: You should seek legal advice.

details.usage: Resmî; gündelikte vote.

examples.text: Millions of people cast their votes.

details.usage: Mecazi: bir konuyu açıklığa kavuşturmak.

examples.text: The study sheds light on the causes of the disease.
Losing the final was a bitter disappointment.
examples.tr: Finali kaybetmek büyük bir hayal kırıklığıydı.

examples.text: It was a narrow escape; the car nearly hit us.
examples.tr: Ucuz atlattık; araba neredeyse bize çarpıyordu.

examples.text: He expressed deep regret for his actions.
examples.tr: Yaptıkları için derin pişmanlığını dile getirdi.

examples.text: I have a dull pain in my shoulder.

details.usage: Genelde "in sharp contrast to" kalıbıyla.

examples.text: His calm was in sharp contrast to her panic.
examples.tr: Onun sakinliği, kadının panik hâliyle keskin bir tezat oluşturuyordu.

examples.text: There is growing concern about climate change.
examples.tr: İklim değişikliğiyle ilgili artan bir endişe var.

examples.text: They had a heated argument about money.
examples.tr: Para yüzünden hararetli bir tartışma yaşadılar.

examples.text: She greeted us with a broad smile.
It was pitch dark outside.
We are deeply concerned about his health.

details.usage: Soğuk için "bitterly" sabit vurgudur; "bitterly hot" denmez.

examples.text: It was bitterly cold that morning.
examples.tr: O sabah dondurucu bir soğuk vardı.

examples.text: That idea is utterly ridiculous.
I was deeply moved by her story.
The fans were bitterly disappointed.
examples.tr: Taraftarlar derin bir hayal kırıklığına uğradı.

examples.text: The internet is painfully slow today.
examples.tr: İnternet bugün sinir bozacak kadar yavaş.

details.usage: "Heavily" etkiyi güçlendirir: heavily influenced by.

examples.text: His music is heavily influenced by jazz.
This information is readily available online.
He smiled broadly when he saw us.
I deeply regret what I said.
I tried to cook dinner but failed miserably.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeği yapmaya çalıştım ama fena çuvalladım.

examples.text: The government declared a state of emergency.
